disclaimer: Statuses come from submitted forms, support tickets, published requirements, and exchange replies.

funding.note: Funds are reserved for the first exchange that approves BTC09 and confirms its current integration, custody, liquidity, withdrawal, delisting, and refund terms. StakeCube is the current target because it is tracked by CoinMarketCap, so a market there also unlocks the price trackers that require an existing tracked market. Their exchange-wide volume is small, so this buys price discovery rather than liquidity.

exchanges.name: StakeCube
exchanges.public_note: A CoinMarketCap tracked venue that runs its own node infrastructure for proof-of-work coins, so a market there would also unlock the price trackers that need a tracked market first. Published native coin fee is US$1,000. Their reported exchange-wide volume is small, so this would buy price discovery rather than liquidity. Their page also mentions cross listing and individual agreements, so those were asked about on 2026-08-05, along with what would have to change for a yes. No payment made.

exchanges.name: NestEx
exchanges.public_note: Enquiry emailed 2026-08-07 about discretionary listing for native non-EVM 09C. Reply 2026-08-07: NestEx finds the project interesting, will have coders review code and integration, then respond. They said published listing instructions look rigid but they are more flexible in practice. Published cash list is still about US$500 listing plus US$150 USDT and US$150 coin liquidity, plus an unquoted integration fee by complexity. No payment made.

exchanges.name: Azbit
exchanges.public_note: Listing enquiry submitted through their asset form. They have integrated native chains recently. Terms were not published, so they were requested rather than assumed.

exchanges.name: Haveno
exchanges.public_note: Free community listing proposal opened on the Haveno listing repo (issue #95). Acceptance is discretionary; if approved, a project/community PR is still required to implement wallet support. This is a non-custodial P2P Monero-based DEX path, not a CEX market.

aggregators_note: Price trackers are separate from exchanges. Most of them will not list an asset until it trades on a market they already track, so the first order book unlocks the rest.

aggregators.name: Blockspot
aggregators.public_note: Listed and verified on 2026-08-06, the first public listing of 09C anywhere. Blockspot validated the chain parameters, supply and explorer against the project's own endpoints and issued their verified badge. It is a directory listing, not a market: there is still no price because 09C does not trade anywhere.

aggregators.name: CoinMarketCap
aggregators.public_note: New-asset application submitted through the official form, requesting untracked (Preview) status until a tracked market exists. Receipt confirmed by ticket. The paid fast-track was declined; the free review queue has no guaranteed timeline.

aggregators.name: CoinRanking
aggregators.public_note: Requires the coin to trade on an exchange it already tracks, so it is blocked until a first market exists.

aggregators.name: CoinGecko
aggregators.public_note: Requires active trading with real volume on a tracked exchange. Blocked until a first market exists.

aggregators.name: CoinPaprika
aggregators.public_note: Requires the asset to be tradable on a supported exchange. Blocked until a first market exists.

aggregators.name: LiveCoinWatch
aggregators.public_note: Requires at least one exchange listing. Blocked until a first market exists.
